title: Coastal cities map new flood defenses
text: A coalition of coastal cities is mapping flood defenses after a winter of unusually high tides. Engineers say the shared plan will prioritize neighborhoods with limited evacuation routes.

title: Grid operators prepare for a hotter summer
text: Regional grid operators are testing new demand-response programs ahead of summer. Utilities expect household cooling demand to rise, while battery storage projects are entering their first full season.

title: Researchers track pollinator corridors across farms
text: A university-led study is measuring pollinator movement between farms that planted native hedgerows. Early field notes show several bee species using the corridors during spring flowering.

title: Transit agencies test all-door boarding
text: Three transit agencies have begun testing all-door boarding on busy routes. The pilot aims to reduce dwell time and improve schedule reliability without changing fares.

title: Community clinics expand evening appointments
text: Community clinics in two counties are extending evening appointments for routine care. Local health officials say the schedule change is designed for patients who cannot take time away from work.

title: Small manufacturers share robotics training
text: A new training partnership is helping small manufacturers teach workers to maintain collaborative robots. The program combines short courses with supervised practice on factory equipment.

title: Libraries lend devices for digital skills courses
text: Public libraries are lending tablets to participants in digital skills courses. Librarians say access to a device between classes has helped learners complete online exercises.

title: River basin groups publish shared water data
text: Water agencies and conservation groups have published a shared river-monitoring dataset. The records combine stream gauges and monthly sampling from sites across the basin.

title: Researchers study battery reuse in public buildings
text: A municipal research team is testing reused electric-vehicle batteries in a public building. The pilot will track storage performance and maintenance needs through a full heating season.

title: Farmers compare soil moisture sensors
text: A regional agriculture group is comparing soil moisture sensors across several crop types. Growers will share readings to understand when low-cost tools can support irrigation decisions.

title: City pilots safer routes near schools
text: A city is piloting redesigned crossings near six schools after parents and staff raised concerns about morning traffic. The changes include longer crossing times and clearer curb markings.

title: Clinics coordinate heat health outreach
text: Public health teams are coordinating heat-safety outreach with clinics and neighborhood groups. The plan includes targeted calls to residents who may need help during prolonged hot weather.
